Save the Doodle

Guess the hidden word one letter at a time, before the eraser rubs out the whole doodle.

How to play

  • A hidden word is shown as blanks, with a clue about what kind of word it is.
  • Tap a letter. If it's in the word, it's written into every blank where it goes.
  • If it isn't, the eraser rubs out part of the doodle.
  • Fill in the whole word to save the doodle. Lose the whole doodle and the word is shown.
  • Save words in a row to build your streak.
